name: OnePage Checkout Lite for WHMCS
author: devbunchuk

sections.description:
OnePage Checkout Lite for WHMCS simplifies the WHMCS checkout experience by transforming it into a user-friendly, single-page process within WordPress.
This plugin connects to external services like WHMCS, Google, and Facebook to facilitate login and order processing.

External Services

This plugin uses the following third-party services to provide social login functionality and WHMCS integration:

1. Facebook OAuth

  • Purpose: Enables Facebook login on the checkout page.
  • Data Sent: Authorization request including client ID and redirect URI.
  • When: Sent when a user clicks the Facebook login button.
  • Service URL: https://www.facebook.com/dialog/oauth
  • Token Exchange: https://graph.facebook.com/oauth/access_token
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy
  • Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms

2. Google OAuth

  • Purpose: Enables Google login on the checkout page.
  • Data Sent: Authorization token, client ID, and redirect URI.
  • When: Sent when a user clicks the Google login button.
  • Service URLs:
    • https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token
    • https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms

3. WHMCS API

  • Purpose: Integrates WHMCS order handling and retrieves product configuration.
  • Data Sent: Order form data and authentication credentials for WHMCS.
  • When: Sent when loading the checkout form or submitting an order.
  • Service URL: Your own WHMCS installation URL (configurable).
  • Privacy Policy: Depends on your WHMCS installation.
sections.installation:
1. Download the OnePage Checkout Lite for WHMCS plugin ZIP file from [your download source].
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to the “Plugins” menu on the left-hand side.
  4. Click on “Add New” at the top of the Plugins page.
  5. On the Add Plugins page, click the “Upload Plugin” button.
  6. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now.”
  7. Once the installation is complete, click “Activate Plugin.”
